notes: Synthetic case, no real patient data. WHAT THIS TESTS: the § 6 Abs. 2 Analogansatz against the exclusion table. The optical coherence tomography has no position in the 1982 Gebuehrenverzeichnis, so its analog ladder is Nr. 750 (0.75), Nr. 410 (0.55), Nr. 5 (0.25). Nr. 750 and Nr. 410 are both already billed directly, so the collision objective - the highest-priority one - pushes the ladder down to Nr. 5, and Nr. 5 is not chargeable next to the Nr. 7 examination under the verified rule excl_man_5_7. EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR: Nr. 5 is BLOCKED with reason exclusion and blocked_by Nr. 7, carrying the rule id and a proof atom; the Analogansatz falls back to Nr. 750 and reports the collision for human review. Before the analog/exclusion fix the two legality constraints in logic/asp/goae_optimize.lp ranged over bill/1, which an analog position never enters, so the solver charged Nr. 5 next to Nr. 7 and the validator refused the whole invoice with a 500. This case is the regression gate for that.
